sentence1: 5. Children 5.1 We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from anyone under 14 years old or knowingly allow such persons to register. sentence1: King Profile When you play our games, we will give you a unique identifier which we will associate with a King account known as a "King Profile". Others players in a game may be able to see your progress in the game and other information such as your game achievements, but no personally identifying information will be visible to other players.
